messages:
jen: heads-up — deploybot just skipped a publish for service-payment on staging, flagged as ambiguous repo namespace.

deploybot: publish skipped for image `service-payment:v1.32.0` 
reason: ambiguous repository namespace detected: 'registry.redwood.io/service-payment' and 'registry.redwood.io/eu/service-payment' both match tag. refusing automatic promote to staging to avoid provenance collision.

alex: ugh, namespace shadowing again? when did the eu mirror get created?

maria: looks like a mirror-only job added the eu/ prefix last week for regional testing. didn't update the promotion rules.

jen: can we still promote the digest manually? we need this in staging for tomorrow's canary.

tim: yes — manual promote by digest should be safe. we should avoid reusing the same unqualified tag. plan: pin staging deploy to the explicit sha and retag the staging repo with a region suffix.

maria: grabbing the image info now.

maria: `aws ecr describe-images --repository-name eu/service-payment --image-ids imageTag=v1.32.0` returned sha `sha256:4a7b...c2f1`.

jen: paste the promote command we want in the PR so release engineers can run it.

tim: propose this flow:
```
# copy by digest to staging-qualified repo
skopeo copy \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/eu/service-payment@sha256:4a7b...c2f1 \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/staging/service-payment-region-eu:promote-1768804242
# then pin deploybot config to digest
deploybot set-pin --service=service-payment --env=staging --image=registry.redwood.io/staging/service-payment-region-eu@sha256:4a7b...c2f1
```

alex: sounds good. also update release notes to make explicit we're using region-qualified images in staging to avoid confusion.

kai: we'll need a short change window for the manual promote and a rollback plan. suggest 20min at 21:00 UTC tonight — low traffic.

jen: rollback criteria: if staging sees >5% error rate or latency regression >200ms within the first 10 minutes, revert pin and demote canary. add a revert script in the PR.

maria: I'll open the PR with the skopeo step + deploybot pin + small revert script, and add release-note section.

deploybot: note: automatic retry disabled for ambiguous-namespace events. manual intervention required.

tim: one more safety: add a lint rule to the publish job to reject identical unqualified tags across multiple repo prefixes. I'll file a quick ticket.

alex: ack. once PR is up, please @kai and me so we can approve and run the promote during the 21:00 window.

kai: on calendar. leaving a note in release notes draft.

jen: thanks all. main action items: maria PR + deploy time 21:00 UTC + tim lint ticket. :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

maria: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/1428 — includes promote + pin + revert. tagging @kai @alex @tim

jen: running promote during window. will post results here.
